steps.name: Preview is up while the agent works
steps.goal: Wait for the 'My building app' card. Only inspect it and do not tap anything.
steps.done: The card shows the inline web preview, and its icon carries a small dot labelled as still building.

steps.name: The turn ends
steps.goal: Tap the 'Agent is working. End the turn' button once.
steps.done: The button now says the agent is idle, and the card's dot is labelled up to date.

steps.name: The dot settles away
steps.goal: Do not tap anything. Wait until the card no longer shows the up to date mark.
steps.done: The card shows the preview with no freshness dot at all.
